tags.feature: A new Villain has joined the dark ranks of Undead Onslaught — the vampiric noble, Seraphyne Von Eldrath! With her crimson blades, swarms of bats, and blood-cursed sorcery, she is as elegant as she is deadly. Let’s take a closer look at her powers and talents.

Blood Pact applies the Soulbind Curse to nearby enemies. While cursed, damage taken by one is shared among all, letting Seraphyne spread pain across entire groups.

Dash – Midnight Hunt: Transform into a bat and dash through enemies, applying Bleed.

notes.title: Update 1.3.5 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Villains of Undead Onslaught![/h1]


The time has finally arrived—Update 1.3.5 is officially LIVE! 🎉 Prepare yourselves to unleash chaos on a whole new level with this massive update, featuring incredible new and reworked talents for ALL Villains, exciting new Blood damage type, and a long awaited overhaul for waves of enemies! 

You can read more about new talents here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/2985840/announcements/detail/518585893687132763

...and about massive talent overhauls and new Blood damage type here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/2985840/announcements/detail/518586511734604453

Now, today let's talk about the wave overhaul! 

[h1]🧠 Smarter, Deadlier, Braver: The Evolution of Your Enemies[/h1]
[h3]⚔️ From Stat Blocks to Behavior-Driven Enemies[/h3]
In the early waves of Undead Onslaught, your enemies were mostly defined by numbers — higher health, faster speed, stronger attacks. They were brave, yes... but simple.

Not anymore.

As the game has evolved, so have the forces of good. They're no longer just waves of villagers with different outfits. Now, they come in two distinct classes:

Horde Enemies – fast, numerous, and relentless.

Special Enemies – elite units with unique behaviors, auras, and abilities that can completely change how you play.

This is more than difficulty scaling. This is a shift in how Undead Onslaught challenges you.

[h3]👥 Horde Enemies: The Shield Wall Crumbles or Crushes[/h3]
Enemies like Villagers, Hawks, Mercenaries, and the new Angels represent the bulk of the resistance. They're fast. They're everywhere. And when left unchecked, they drown you in righteous numbers.

But now, they're not alone.

[h3]🎯 Special Enemies: Behavior Over Stats[/h3]
Our real focus in this update has been giving special enemies distinct personalities and battlefield roles:

[b]🛡️ Royal Infantry[/b] doesn’t just tank — it activates Shield Wall, reducing frontal damage and forcing you to reposition.

[b]🕳️ Rogues and Hunters [/b]pause to throw projectiles — predictable if you notice their cast time, deadly if you don’t.

[b]🧠 Adventurers [/b]seek out [b]Blacksmiths[/b] to get buffs, becoming far more dangerous if you let them succeed.

👼 [b]Archangels[/b] don't attack directly — but their buff aura can turn an entire swarm into an unstoppable wall of light.

Each special enemy now asks you to make decisions: Do you take out the support? Burn down the ranged threat? Avoid the area-control golem? Or just try to survive?

This is no longer a numbers game.
It’s a thinking one.
---

P.S. Necronomicon entries for enemies have been updated with descriptions of their behaviors and abilities.

---
Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey. Now go forth, Villains, and dominate the world of Undead Onslaught!

Your continued support and feedback mean the world to us—please share your thoughts on these new additions as you play!

With deepest gratitude,
The Wish App Games Team

notes.title: What's Coming in 1.3.5: Part 1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Villains of Undead Onslaught![/h1]

We’re excited to unveil the first glimpse of [b]Update 1.3.5,[/b] coming to Early Access very very soon! This mid-season patch focuses on one of our most-requested features: **a brand-new fourth row of talents** for every Villain, unlocking powerful new build synergies and playstyles. Read on for a sneak peek at what’s coming!

---

[h3]🔥 Lord Cinderhell [/h3]
Cinderhell fans, rejoice! You’ll finally be able to supercharge [b]Hellbreath [/b]builds with the new [b]Scorching Dominion[/b] talent.  
- [b]Scorching Dominion [/b]adds an extra synergy with Cinderhell’s class mechanic, vastly improving the spread and potency of your Burn effects.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/cc9aba1ed6fba462a374a6896df11d5eb7895885.png[/img]

Pair it with your existing Burn-over-time talents for massive area-of-effect devastation.  
---

[h3]⚡ Zargoth the Stormcaller [/h3]
Our resident evil shaman will have his unqiue Passive "Elemental Mastery" improved in it's base form to:  
1. Replace Physical damage bonus with Frost damage in its base form  
2. Temporarily supercharge all bonuses whenever a Blood Drop is picked up  

And now a new suite of talents to further empower his [b]Elemental Mastery[/b] passive will be available:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/604bbaea6470ea30740b8c97305f8ee6497dabd0.png[/img]

Choose talents that boost your favorite element—fire, frost, or lightning—and add new strategic layers to your shamanic build.  
---

[h3] 🌑 Vespera Darkmoon [/h3]
Even our creepy dark ranger gets more toys to play with. Vespera’s [b]Shadowbarb Chains[/b] with her new talents would have extra optional effects to:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/be611f568302a50b086c981e071678cbc29b6315.png[/img]

Experiment to find the perfect balance between offense and elusiveness.  
---

[h3]❄️ Cordemal the Cold [/h3]
The Frozen Magus embraces darker powers! New talents let Cordemal:  
- Cordemal's abilities will now count as Both Frost and the new 🩸[b]Blood[/b] damage type coming in the next update!  
- Use Potion for additional boost of Blood damage type weapons!

Mix and match to create efficient blood-chilling builds.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/5e3b05e5fd7397dfd484bb2151b4da15a904521e.png[/img]

---

[h3] ⚔️ Rend Warbringer [/h3]
Rend’s rage now shocks the battlefield—literally. His new talents allow you to:  
- Add [b]Shock [/b]damage to all his Unique abilities
- His basic attacks gain a ranged component!  

Unleash electrical fury alongside your trademark berserker onslaught.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/352a11ff52c716ff82bdf6217285ba98ad4b2daf.png[/img]

---

[h3]…And More for All 11 Villains!  [/h3]
Every Villain in the roster—from Forgotten the Spectral Knight to Aurelian of the Sunfall—will receive a brand-new fourth row of talents. That means dozens of fresh build combinations to discover and master!

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Villains of Undead Onslaught![/h1]

The time has finally arrived—Update 1.3 is officially LIVE! 🎉 Prepare yourselves to unleash chaos on a whole new level with this massive update, featuring an incredible visual overhaul, exciting new playable villains, and brand-new features designed to empower your reign of terror!

[h2]Major Visual Overhaul: A World Remade in Darkness 🌑[/h2]
The battlefield has transformed into a darker, richer, and more immersive experience than ever before. The environment and visual effects have undergone significant upgrades, making every encounter feel intense and sinister. From gloomy forests to blood-stained plains, each location now pulsates with dark energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/ba0e078164b4fa2e8f0ecd67f2363dc5f15bda4f.png[/img]

And YES! Blood effects have finally arrived! Vanquish your foes and spill their blood in honor of your dark ambitions. While blood fades over time, higher Onslaught Levels make it linger, allowing you to literally paint the battlefield crimson! 🩸

[h2]Two (or more?!) New Playable Villains Join the Fray! 😈[/h2]
We promised two, but there have been whispers... could there be more lurking in the shadows?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/8817a99f33aff5a2ab85b94823b6678829442010.jpg[/img]
[b]Vespera Darkmoon: The Dark Ranger[/b]

Once a trusted commander of the Shadow Blades, Vespera Darkmoon was betrayed and left for dead by the King of Arkenmarsh. Now she harnesses forbidden magic and precise combat skills, striking from the shadows to exact her revenge. Wielding deadly Shadowgrasp Daggers and unleashing curses, Vespera cripples enemies and masters the battlefield with devastating waves of dark magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/2788e5b0ca29c030fa21eb3a0740911002f1e65d.gif[/img]

[b]The Dark Ascendant[/b]
A mysterious being rumored to have arrived from a bleak future, the Dark Ascendant is shrouded in mystery and immense demonic power. Armed with Hellfire and Dark energy, he obliterates enemies with explosive force and precision. Harness the fury of his dark abilities and leave nothing but devastation in your wake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/43421a5dee04a9410ca231e54768bfb11b7b42fe.jpg[/img]

And while we're confident that the number of new villains is two, whispers speak of something...darker. What could these dark rumors mean? Only time (or your discovery) will tell...

[h3]Scoring System & Performance Rewards 📊[/h3]
Each run now concludes with a detailed scoring screen, rating your villainous performance. Earn valuable rewards such as Coins and Magical Stones based on your score, perfect for upgrading your 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/437cf08486bd890b7f042b55cfb8aa3672f3e892.jpg[/img]

[h3]Obelisks of Power & Dark Offerings🗿[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/a01d69b66986435a4ea869320653aa40fd2c6480.jpg[/img]

[b]Permanent Obelisks[/b]: Stackable small permanent buffs enhancing your villain.

[b]Temporary Obelisks[/b]: Powerful temporary buffs, with effects amplified further through Tarot Card upgrades.

These Obelisks provide strategic depth and flexibility in building your villain, adapting to every situation.

[h3]Run History & Detailed Stats📜[/h3]
To help you better strategize and learn from your triumphs (and missteps), we've introduced the Run History & Detailed Stats feature. You can now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/6b3de8456b3c196272885e9f8acf488b38cc818b.jpg[/img]

Track your recent runs for every villain.

Analyze detailed statistics, from builds to kill counts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/58ddca7224aef2af79bbf3f5da6ed9ef5ee5f229.jpg[/img]

Perfect your strategies based on past performance!

[h3]Massive Quality of Life Improvements 🛠️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/9cef9fb40cc9345d476af86087ace540ad463b72.jpg[/img]

[b]Tarot Card Rebalancing[/b]: More strategic choices and flexible upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/8eb03db47b31a2fcbb22b49a1b8d92bed874ca77.jpg[/img]

However, some features designed for this mode made it into the base game, enriching your experience even further! (Dark Offerings and Dark Obelisks)


Your continued support and feedback mean the world to us—please share your thoughts on these new additions as you play!

notes.title: Details on Third Major Update 1.3 (part 1!)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Villains of Undead Onslaught![/h1]

Between the new features and a lot of spilled blood (literally), we’re beyond excited to share what’s on the horizon for your villainous escapades. 🦹‍♂️

Let’s dive into the key highlights of Update 1.3!🎉

[h3]🎨Major Visual Overhaul: A Darker, Bloodier World Awaits[/h3]
The lands you’ve ravaged are getting a stunning new look! We’re introducing a brand-new map with a fresh environment, enhanced visual effects, and yes—actual blood effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/ba0e078164b4fa2e8f0ecd67f2363dc5f15bda4f.png[/img]

Prepare for a world that’s not just more immersive but also a whole lot messier. >:)

[h3]😈Postponing the New Game Mode[/h3]
We’ve thought long and hard about the new game mode we teased previously. Ultimately, we weren’t happy with how it turned out, and we’ve decided not to include it in this update.

[h3]Why?[/h3]
It’s tough being an indie game dev without publisher support, but there’s one big upside: we aren’t forced to ship anything we don’t believe in. Releasing something we don’t find fun would be a disservice to you and our vision for the game. So, while it’s disappointing, we believe this is the right decision.

As always, we’re incredibly grateful for your support. Your feedback, reviews, and villainous passion drive us to make Undead Onslaught the best it can be.

Until next time, keep the chaos alive and paint the world red (or darker shades of evil)!

The Wish App Games Team

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Villains of Undead Onslaught![/h1]

We promised a short Beta for the update and we delivered! 1.2.5 is now LIVE!

 This mini-update is packed with highly-anticipated improvements, new content, and fresh customization options to enhance your journey into darkness.

[h3]Art Style Update: A Fresh Look for All Our Villains[/h3]
After previewing Rend Warbringer’s new look, we’re thrilled to reveal that all of our villains are getting a major visual update! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/c5cace3b7d6767ec1b35f4b10fe4843cd1cff9d8.jpg[/img]

Here is our fan favourite Lord Cinderhell in action!

And here is his "cooler coleague" after the face-lift:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/91dda6ea3272eada9d17030f07f4ae65ed051fdb.gif[/img]

With enhanced details and a darker, more immersive style, each character now embodies the sinister energy that defines Undead Onslaught. Your feedback has been invaluable in this transformation, and we can’t wait for you to see the revamped lineup!

[h3]New Feature: Shrine of Eternal Strife[/h3]
At the start of each run, players can now interact with the Shrine of Eternal Strife to modify the difficulty of their journey. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/9ad9f5bd5c50b5f03c2d71de39b12bd9ed46f6c5.png[/img]

This ancient and ominous shrine allows you to customize the intensity of your run by adjusting three key parameters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/68f4bea77083acca686a234569b99caf59b7930f.gif[/img]

Onslaught Accumulation – Increase the rate at which Onslaught Levels are gained, accelerating the intensity of the run.

Onslaught Level – Set the starting and minimum Onslaught Level, ensuring a constant and challenging baseline of difficulty.

Madness – Control the frequency of tougher, “Blessed” enemies. These elite foes drop increased rewards but present formidable challenges, demanding precise strategy and skill.

The Shrine of Eternal Strife taps into your collected Skulls resource to empower these adjustments. Skulls aren’t consumed by the shrine, but the more Skulls you invest, the stronger the shrine’s effects become. Each villain has their own capacity for how many Skulls they can harness, allowing for unique scaling of the shrine’s power based on their strength and experience.

Prepare for a run tailored to test the very limits of your villain’s power and adaptability!

[h3]New Passives: Customize Your Builds[/h3]
In this update, we’ve added new passives to enhance your villain builds even further! With these fresh options, you can tweak your playstyle and strengthen your favorite abilities, making each run even more personalized and powerful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/e6d35547c0160f3c1bd31ea5db390378681e995e.png[/img]


[h3]Steam Features: Game Recording & Achievements[/h3]

notes.title: Second Major Update is LIVE! (1.2)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Villains of Undead Onslaught![/h1]

Lord Cinderhell was kind enough to show off all the new goodies he could get his hands on in the upcoming 1.2 Update! We were constantly hearing his evil cackling, so I guess we can safely say that at least he’s enjoying the content. >.>

Now, let’s dive into the key features of Update 1.2!

[h3]Ability Evolutions[/h3]
The long-awaited Ability Evolutions are finally here! You can now combine specific max-level active abilities (weapons) and passive skills into a supercharged new skill that’s both visually impressive and utterly devastating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/8cbb98e7c2f2da1f7f44017c9d6de21b57bf8c97.jpg[/img]

For example, the Fire Tornado can now evolve into Soulstorm—in addition to spawning the regular Fire Tornadoes, it summons a Soulstorm Tornado that acts like a minion, constantly hunting enemies to burn and destroy! 🔥🌪️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/312a371c302d634fe5985f477feb150627ec1e76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/b03289d1e9c5c57396c9fec31e01523d19d05f13.gif[/img]

Also, in this update, some talents exclusive to specific villains have been converted into evolutions, as they felt more fitting in this form. But don't worry! Villains who lost those "evolution" talents have received even cooler, brand-new talents. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/83bb280bb3a049f447373128067dad15f2e620bd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Unique Villain Mechanics[/h3]
Each villain now has a unique interactive mechanic right from the start, which automatically upgrades every 5 levels with a visual indicator in the UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/b7d5e1d034f1400295814579bd65b44c4190926e.jpg[/img]

For instance, Lord Cinderhell's old passive, Infernal Domain, has been promoted into his Unique Mechanic! Now, aside from its original effects, it has a power-up indicator. Every enemy burned fills the bar, and once fully charged, Lord Cinderhell gains a 2x Fire Damage bonus for a short time! The bar resets when the effect ends, and the process begins anew.

Every villain will have their own Unique Mechanic, adding more depth and strategy to each playthrough!

[h3]Dark Aspirations[/h3]
Each villain now comes with their own set of Dark Aspirations—personal challenges that will grant a Skull when completed. The first three characters (Rend, Cinderhell, and Cordemal) have relatively simple aspirations that will take about 1-2 runs to complete, unlocking their first row of talents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/287b1df8bbb15c8c1f798764be283352c64bd77b.jpg[/img]

Villains like Taurok, Aphorius, and Zargoth will face more challenging aspirations, taking 3-5 runs on average to complete. Aurelian falls somewhere in between, with aspirations taking 2-4 runs. Lastly, Varkath and two future villains (not arriving in 1.2, but soon!) will have the most difficult aspirations, typically requiring 4+ runs to conquer.

Context: We designed Dark Aspirations to give newer players a meaningful choice after their first run: replay with more talents or try out a different villain. These quests offer a quicker way to unlock the first talent row by earning extra Souls, bypassing some of the RNG (boss drops) or Hero-Slayer mechanics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/ea74108cc44b6dd6cb1e45acfde6d07fe3836bca.jpg[/img]


[h3]Special Traits[/h3]
Each Villain will now have a Starting Trait - basically a Unique Passive Effect (text in green on the right panel). These effects can be quite powerful, so make sure to check Traits for every villain!

Some are powerful Stat bonuses with a special scaling condition:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/085c154e429877f48e7eb1cff55a2cb89df402a3.jpg[/img]

Others are utility options available at certain levels:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/27bf50041bde2c7bc8bdd42690130f02ca5805b5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Extended Talent Trees and Talent Rework[/h3]
As mentioned in last week's newspost regarding talents - we have extended the talent trees for every villain, adding 3 more options at higher Skull Levels and also heavily reworked some of the talents that functioned better as Weapon Evolutions, so had to be replaced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/04385511e0f4a3bcbf3502424ffa9e784f315584.jpg[/img]

Once again, Lord Cinderhell was unkind enough to let us have a sneak peek into some of his new talents:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/636178998d10bc65eb1557399b6f38d4f4bd114a.jpg[/img]

Weirdly chilling, isn't it? Some of these talents can drastically change your Villain's builds! 


[h3]World Quests[/h3]
We have added a new Map Interaction and a source of skulls: World Quests. These are challenging quests, that have a special conditon attached to them. For instance, this one summons an Angel that has an aura, that nullifies all the damage from all your skills as long as he's nearby! Worry not, though, as a portal of Hell will be summoned, where the angels has to be "kindly escorted" into. Doing so yields powerful rewards! It's just a matter of not being torn to shreds by a bunch of angry peasants, while doing 0 damage to them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/571584a0ff9aa7e2df3f58a196757fd496115d0d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Global Events[/h3]
When the World Quests will be unlocked you'll also unlock Global Events. These are random occurances of weird and otherwordly effects on the map! Can you survive through them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/fce6b4113f640c763072faf0acefe96335213087.jpg[/img]

That’s It...that was HUGE! THere are also a bunch of undocumented changes that we are sure you'll have a blast discovering!


As always - special thanks to our Discord members for helping us to make the game better!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/undeadonslaught][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/9287c99207b41f60669900d728eb002a6de73ce7.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for being a part of this journey. Your support is what drives us to make Undead Onslaught the best it can be. Stay tuned for more updates and keep the feedback coming! 


Wish App Games Team

notes.title: First Major Update 1.1 LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Villains of Undead Onslaught![/h1]

It's finally here! the first major content update for the game, introducing a whole batch of new features, content and balance changes! Get ready to face new challenges, unlock powerful rewards, and unleash even more chaos in the world of Undead Onslaught!

[h3]Boss Mechanics and Special Attacks[/h3]
We’re thrilled to introduce a major overhaul to our boss encounters! From now on, each boss and nemesis hero will come equipped with a unique set of mechanics and special attacks. This means every fight will be far more dynamic and challenging, keeping you on your toes as you navigate through these intense battles. Prepare for a more engaging and strategic experience as you take on the most formidable foes the game has to offer!

Is the Bird Mother gonna just charge at us? That's crazy...right? RIGHT?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/5b0f8d1e341c69c771e133f399feadba45a63718.jpg[/img]

There are also overhauled bosses in this update! Village Hero, for instance is now the best bowman in the village! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/22ae8ca7d31d975d5dfb35d61adb592b6dee0c8a.jpg[/img]

Nemesis Heroes have also trained hard to try and even the odds! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/ac7257c29a6d0cc224c15c3a75da5384ed234e68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/9275de77f40c2813c8881a5dcd13f44e484d271f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Special Map Features: Challenge Altars[/h3]
Previously known as Baphomet Statues, we’ve expanded and refined these features into Challenge Altars. These unique map objects now offer you the chance to interact and activate time-limited events that will test your skills and strategies. Successfully completing a challenge will reward you with either an Upgrade Orb (Boss Reward) or a brand-new reward item: the Upgrade Scroll. These scrolls are crucial for powering up your arsenal, so be sure to seek out these altars during your runs!

You will notice a whole array of new map activities now! The Challenge Altars will be shown as en exclamation mark (!) on your minimap! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/50faa5ceba082da942fd2608e18396a3daff06f0.png[/img]

Head over there and accept the challenge! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/2cc094adc071122a1d46e3197c53470828e4d0db.jpg[/img]

Survive the challenge! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/1406389b8104af383e75a5ab2db3c8a2400b666a.jpg[/img]


[h3]Hero Mechanics Rework: Part 1[/h3]
This update marks the beginning of our rework of hero mechanics, starting with your villains’ default weapons. Weapons are now separate from abilities and have their own dedicated slot. While they can still be upgraded through traditional level-ups, this is capped at level 5. However, with the new Upgrade Scrolls, you can push these weapons beyond their limits! These scrolls allow you to upgrade specific stats without any restrictions—go ahead, unleash your inner villain and create the most fearsome weapons imaginable!

Yup, that means an extra Weapon slot to slaughter the forces of Good with! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/2da073147c598011f60b0ab40474fd1433f3e530.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Feature: Quests[/h3]
We’re also introducing a brand-new Quests feature! Periodically, you’ll receive quests from a randomized pool, each requiring you to travel to a specific location and defeat a camp of unique enemies. Some of these camps may even be guarded by a mini-boss, offering extra rewards for those brave enough to take them on. Completing these quests will grant you valuable rewards, including the highly sought-after Upgrade Scrolls.

Kill those pesky interlopers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/7fb168b3b877cf7de835a79b6b108b01283f988e.png[/img]

And gain powerful rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/84c400b0f2881634b8c7fe85ddcb3eb35fe3deb6.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Playable Villain: Varkath the Defiant[/h3]
We’re excited to announce the addition of a brand-new playable villain: Varkath the Defiant! Once a Royal Marksman, Varkath has turned to the dark side, and now you can harness his lethal skills to wreak havoc on your enemies. Unlock Varkath and add his unique abilities to your arsenal of destruction!

A new Villain joins the fray! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/bff4fe22a52bd5d2a6fee54b0f6e0b2db34fde4b.jpg[/img]


[h2]Onslaught Mechanic Rebalance and Overhaul[/h2]
Onslaught mechanic will now grant major benefits per level:
Level 1: Quests will reward +1 Upgrade Scroll!
Level 2: New Currency "Heroic Soul" will have a rare chance to drop from every boss. You can collect only 1 Heroic Soul per run. Use these to unlock higher levels of upgrades for Tarrot Cards. 
Level 3: Upgrade Scrolls will have +1 option to select from!
Level 4: Upgrade Scrolls will no longer have Uncommon options! 
Level 5:  Quests will reward another +1 Upgrade Scroll, for a total max of 3 Scrolls!

It will now be significantly harder to attain onslaught levels, but there will be new Map Objects to help you better control the Onslaught levels! Be on a lookout for them!

P.S. UI will be updated to show the new Onslaught rewards in coming hotfix patches! 


As always - special thanks to our Discord members for helping us to make the game better!


[url=https://discord.com/invite/undeadonslaught][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022834/9287c99207b41f60669900d728eb002a6de73ce7.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for being a part of this journey. Your support is what drives us to make Undead Onslaught the best it can be. Stay tuned for more updates and keep the feedback coming!

With gratitude,
The Wish App Games Team
